# SABXI

> SABXI is a direct-to-consumer (D2C) fresh food brand in India, changing how the world eats. It delivers freshly cut vegetables, freshly cut fruits, cold-pressed juices, raw whole vegetables, raw whole fruits, and blended smoothies — all prepared live at SABXI Studio the moment an order is placed, and delivered to the customer's door in under 30 minutes. Tagline: "Freshly Cut, Quickly Delivered."

## What makes SABXI different

- Nothing is pre-made or warehoused: produce is washed, cut, pressed, and packed only after the customer orders.
- SABXI Studio is a compact, glass-front micro-kitchen built for speed, hygiene, and transparency — customers can watch orders being prepared live.
- Produce is sourced direct from local mandis (wholesale markets) every morning: no middlemen, no markup, no cold storage.
- Delivery in under 30 minutes with live order tracking, available 7 AM to 9 PM daily.
- Daily subscription: customers set a daily basket (e.g. palak, tomatoes, juice) that is auto-delivered fresh every morning at a discount.
- Positioning: while dark-store quick commerce (e.g. Zepto, Blinkit) solved speed for packaged goods, SABXI solves freshness at speed — the fresh food layer of quick commerce.

## Product lines (six)

1. Cut Veggies — diced, sliced, or julienned to the customer's spec (tomatoes, onions, palak, carrots, stir-fry mixes, salad cuts)
2. Cut Fruits — seasonal fruit bowls and slices (watermelon, papaya, apple, mixed fruit)
3. Fresh Juices — cold-pressed on order (orange, green detox, watermelon mint, carrot ginger)
4. Whole Vegetables — raw, mandi-fresh, by the kilo
5. Whole Fruits — raw seasonal fruits by the kilo (apples, bananas, oranges, grapes)
6. Smoothies — thick blended smoothies (berry, mango, banana oats, seasonal specials)

## Ordering

- App-only ordering (iOS and Android apps coming soon); join the waitlist at https://sabxi.com/
- Delivery window: 7 AM – 9 PM, under 30 minutes per order
- Contact: hello@sabxi.com
